result.brief: 提出基于视频扩散骨干的指令图像序列生成框架，通过空间冻结训练与指令感知适配器分离时序对齐与单帧质量优化，提升跨帧一致性与步骤忠实度。
result.reason: Uses video diffusion backbone with frozen spatial layers and temporal adapters for consistent multi-step image-sequence generation, directly informing video generation consistency and controllable generation.
